+/*
+ * @test
+ * @bug 8389111
+ * @requires vm.simpleArch == "x64" & vm.flavor == "server"
+ * @library /test/lib /
+ * @modules java.base/jdk.internal.misc
+ *          java.management
+ *
+ * @build jdk.test.whitebox.WhiteBox
+ * @run driver jdk.test.lib.helpers.ClassFileInstaller jdk.test.whitebox.WhiteBox
+ * @run main/bootclasspath/othervm -Xbatch -XX:+UnlockDiagnosticVMOptions -XX:+WhiteBoxAPI -XX:+AbortVMOnCompilationFailure
+ *      -XX:CompileCommand=compileonly,compiler.intrinsics.bmi.*::*
+ *      -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseBMI2Instructions
+ *      compiler.intrinsics.bmi.verifycode.BzhiTestI
+ */
+
+package compiler.intrinsics.bmi.verifycode;
+
+import compiler.intrinsics.bmi.TestBzhiI;
+
+import java.lang.reflect.Method;
+
+public class BzhiTestI extends BmiIntrinsicBase.BmiTestCase {
+
+    protected BzhiTestI(Method method) {
+        super(method);
+
+        cpuFlag = "bmi2";
+        vmFlag = "UseBMI2Instructions";
+
+        // from intel manual VEX.LZ.0F38.W0 F5 /r
+        instrMask = new byte[]{
+            (byte) 0xFF,
+            (byte) 0x1F,
+            (byte) 0x87,
+            (byte) 0xFF};
+        instrPattern = new byte[]{
+            (byte) 0xC4,    // prefix for 3-byte VEX instruction
+            (byte) 0x02,    // 00010 implied 0F 38 leading opcode bytes
+            (byte) 0x00,    // W0, L0 and no implied prefix, which tells BZHI from PDEP and PEXT
+            (byte) 0xF5};
+
+        // from intel apx specifications EVEX.128.NP.0F38.W0 F5 /r
+        instrMaskAPX = new byte[]{
+                (byte) 0xFF,
+                (byte) 0x07,
+                (byte) 0x00,
+                (byte) 0x00,
+                (byte) 0xFF};
+
+        instrPatternAPX = new byte[]{
+                (byte) 0x62, // fixed prefix byte 0x62 for extended EVEX instruction
+                (byte) 0x02, // 00010 implied 0F 38 leading opcode bytes
+                (byte) 0x00,
+                (byte) 0x00,
+                (byte) 0xF5};
+    }
+
+    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
+        BmiIntrinsicBase.verifyTestCase(BzhiTestI::new, TestBzhiI.BzhiIExpr.class.getDeclaredMethods());
+        BmiIntrinsicBase.verifyTestCase(BzhiTestI::new, TestBzhiI.BzhiICommutativeExpr.class.getDeclaredMethods());
+        BmiIntrinsicBase.verifyTestCase(BzhiTestI::new, TestBzhiI.BzhiIShiftedSourceExpr.class.getDeclaredMethods());
+        BmiIntrinsicBase.verifyTestCase(BzhiTestI::new, TestBzhiI.BzhiISameValueExpr.class.getDeclaredMethods());
+    }
+}
